title: When I need to manage WhatsApp conversations across multiple team members, I want a shared inbox wit
target_user: Small Business Owner / Customer Support Manager
job_to_be_done: When I need to manage WhatsApp conversations across multiple team members, I want a shared inbox with multi-agent support that allows simultaneous access and automatic assignment, so I can respond quickly, avoid missed messages, and maintain a single customer conversation history.
painful_workflow: Only one device can be logged into WhatsApp Business at a time, so team members must manually forward messages, take turns on a single phone, or use unofficial workarounds to share access.
current_workaround: Using multiple phones with SIM cloning, manually forwarding messages to personal WhatsApp, taking turns on a single device, or using WhatsApp Web with a shared QR code.

competitors.name: WATI

competitors.pricing: Plans from approximately $49/month (Growth) to $299/month (Business), plus Meta conversation fees; 7-day free trial.
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp Business API for support and sales, focused on small and medium businesses

competitors.pricing: Conversation-based fees from Meta; free to access through BSPs

substitutes.name: Multiple phones with SIM cloning
substitutes.description: Manual duplication of SIM/account across devices; violates WhatsApp ToS and is operationally risky

substitutes.name: Manual forwarding to personal WhatsApp
substitutes.description: Team members forward conversations to personal numbers, losing unified history and assignment

substitutes.name: Shared WhatsApp Web session (QR code)
substitutes.description: Multiple agents use the same WhatsApp Web session on different laptops; no assignment, collision, or audit trail

substitutes.name: Using personal WhatsApp groups or broadcasts
substitutes.description: Ad-hoc group chats for internal coordination, not a customer-facing shared inbox

verified_facts: Users manually forward WhatsApp messages between team members because only one device can be logged into WhatsApp Business at a time (SIG-001).
Users share a single WhatsApp Business number by logging in/out of the same device or using unofficial workarounds (SIG-004).
Users handle customer support inquiries through WhatsApp alongside Shopify Inbox, manually switching between apps (SIG-008).
inferences: The problem occurs for small businesses with multiple support staff who need to share a single WhatsApp Business number.
The current workarounds are time-consuming and may lead to missed messages or inconsistent customer history.
Users are not using the official WhatsApp Business API (which supports multi-agent) likely due to cost, complexity, or lack of awareness.
assumptions: The frequency of the problem is at least weekly for affected users.
Users have not tried or cannot afford paid multi-agent solutions like WhatsApp Business API or third-party tools.
The pain is consistent across different small business verticals.
unknowns: Actual frequency of the problem (daily vs. weekly).
Economic impact (lost revenue, customer churn) – not quantified.
Willingness to pay for a solution – no evidence of spending.
Whether existing solutions (WhatsApp Business API, WATI, etc.) adequately address the need.
